title: AI Energy Readiness: Aligning AI Ambition with Power Systems | World Economic Forum
text: As AI infrastructure rapidly scales, digital and energy-system decisions are becoming increasingly interconnected. Electricity consumption at AI-focused data centres is expected to triple by 2030, making coordination across governments, utilities, industry and communities essential to achieving competitive, resilient AI outcomes and closing AI energy readiness gaps. Readiness requires matching AI ambitions to an ecosystem’s capacity to support competitive, net-positive development while reinforcing, rather than burdening, existing systems.Developed by the World Economic Forum with Accenture, The AI Energy Readiness Compass: Aligning AI Ambition with Energy System Realities offers a practical methodology for moving from individual ambition to collective action. It guides stakeholders through five steps: assessing constraints and innovations, engaging actors, evaluating strategic choices, building an action plan, and monitoring and adapting as conditions evolve.Drawing on real-world examples, the report shows how stakeholders can shape AI and energy development together to strengthen energy systems and generate inclusive value.Join the AI Energy Impact Global Community to apply the Compass, share insights and help shape more inclusive AI scaling.Follow this topic.
